messages:
maria: Auditor asked for end-to-end evidence for a temporary RBAC binding during the model migration: who requested it, approvals, terraform diff, KMS decrypt events, and vuln triage linkage.

ryan: That was the svc-migrate cluster-admin binding in namespace inference for ~2h. I can pull terraform plan and state.

priya: I will export PR #482 approval history and screenshots from GitHub (approvers: eng-lead, jenkins-bot).

sam: I'll export CloudKMS audit events for the CMK for migration window +/- 1h and include the search query and SID.

jen: VULN-391 is the vuln ticket (CVE-2024-9876). I'll attach the JIRA export showing detection -> mitigation -> verification and link to INC-2026.

compliance-bot: Reminder: missing signed exception = finding. Retroactive risk acceptance by owner within 5 business days can mitigate. Corporate service account emails are acceptable in evidence.

maria: Also include controller logs proving the binding was revoked (controller event and timestamp), commit hash used (abc123), and kubectl rollout history for serve-api.

ryan: I'll grab controller logs and terraform applied state snapshots.

priya: Note: CMK rotated same week (AddNewKeyVersion). I'll include keyVersion IDs and rotation timestamps and backup verification output.

sam: I'll deliver CSV export of decrypt events, query text, and search SID.

maria: Action items: priya - PR export; sam - KMS logs; jen - JIRA crosswalk; ryan - terraform & logs; maria - executive summary + request retro sign-off. Target upload to auditor share by EOD tomorrow.

priya: Uploading PR export now.

sam: Starting Splunk export.

ryan: Gathering terraform and logs.

maria: Thanks everyone. Post the manifest when uploaded and I'll validate the bundle.
